body mass per species (not a NeuroMorpho field)

summary: Soma size across species is available at scale in NeuroMorpho (300k reconstructions, 95 species, 16 ganglion region labels), but it samples selected neurons and has no body-size field. Whole-ganglion cell counts across a body-size gradient exist only for insect brains in one Dryad table (Hymenoptera); no dataset pairs homologous-ganglion counts with soma size and body mass across phyla.
next_step: Pull NeuroMorpho morphometry for ganglion-labelled neurons by species, join species body mass from AnAge/the organisms tables, and add the Hymenoptera cell-number table; the cross-phylum count comparison still needs literature compilation (e.g. Aplysia, leech, crustacean stomatogastric ganglion counts).
obstacles_confirmed: Repositories emphasize selected neurons rather than unbiased cell counts.
Reconstructions over-represent mammalian cortex rather than whole ganglia of small invertebrates.
